body:
Ms. Paws names only the FIRST missing thing (rules-* big-needs pets).

Pet care level: "{Pet}s need a lot of care. Reach Pet care {n} first!"
Pet yard level: "A {pet} needs lots of space. Grow your pet yard to level 3!"
Home: "Where would it live? Get a {home} first!" (monkey: climbing tree, seal: pond, bear: cave den, snake: glass tank in your house)
Animal license: "You need an animal license, level {n}. Win at the Pet Show!"
All ready: "Everything is ready. {Pet} will love your home!"
Sick pet given away: "Oh no, {Pet} is sick. Take {Pet} to the vet first."

Never says 'exotic' (rule).
short: Ms. Paws says the first thing a locked pet needs
title: Ms. Paws: locked pet lines
